stemMd: If a+b=13 and ab=36, what is (a−b) squared?
explanationMd: Use (a−b) squared=(a+b) squared−4ab=169−144=25. The numbers 4 and 9 satisfy the conditions and provide a check.

distractorRationale.e: This is the square of the sum.
